atomic_commit.reading: Owner ruling R4 (2026-10-01): one commit per feature or fix. A0 spec section 7.6 is read as A0's machinery landing as separate feature and fix commits, all contained in the bound candidate; no single atomic A0 commit is required and no history is rewritten.
atomic_commit.note: The reading of the atomic-commit clause for an A0 whose machinery already landed across several commits is owner ruling R4; this record neither rewrites history nor fabricates a feature diff.
